title: BPP activation_policy_adopt request (DESIGN.md §7.3; registry R13 participant)
description: Mutation (meta required). Adopts (or, with previous_digest, replaces) an ActivationPolicyRevision over the authenticated Participant channel only (§7.3). Field names verbatim from the record shape; server-derived fields as for assent_policy_adopt. Ceiling/selector bodies are opaque pending BPA-1 — gap note G10.

purpose_and_context_ceilings.description: Opaque body pending the BPA-1 policy-algebra slice (ADR-0001); gap note G10.

budget_rate_and_concurrency_ceilings.description: Opaque body pending the BPA-1 policy-algebra slice (ADR-0001); gap note G10.

allowed_manifestation_selector.description: Opaque body pending the BPA-1 policy-algebra slice (ADR-0001); gap note G10.

schedule_constraints.description: Opaque body pending the BPA-1 policy-algebra slice (ADR-0001); gap note G10.

previous_digest.description: Prior revision digest when replacing (§7.3 revision chain).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.

mutationMeta.description: MutationMeta (§14.2). Required on every mutation; update operations additionally supply expected_revision (registry rule enforced in code, not expressible here).
